properties.name: mybatis-repository.timezone
properties.description: Zone ID used as the wall clock for datetime literals in generated SQL (for example Asia/Seoul). Defaults to UTC; java.util.Date and java.sql.Timestamp fall back to the JVM default zone while this is unset.

properties.name: mybatis-repository.created-at
properties.description: Java field name that holds the creation timestamp. Filled on INSERT only, and only when a MybatisAuditorAware bean is registered. Entities without such a field are left alone.

properties.name: mybatis-repository.created-by
properties.description: Java field name that holds the creator identifier. Filled on INSERT only, and only when a MybatisAuditorAware bean is registered. Must be a String field.

properties.name: mybatis-repository.updated-at
properties.description: Java field name that holds the modification timestamp. Filled on INSERT and UPDATE, and only when a MybatisAuditorAware bean is registered.

properties.name: mybatis-repository.updated-by
properties.description: Java field name that holds the modifier identifier. Filled on INSERT and UPDATE, and only when a MybatisAuditorAware bean is registered. Must be a String field.
